servedFrom: a dev server started from the BRANCH worktree, not canonical master
mode: editorial — MODE "development", VITE_PUBLIC_SITE unset, so CAN_EDIT is true
portProof: port 5199 chosen after confirming only 5173 and 5174 were listening; the serving process command line resolves to the worktree path

receiptTreeReconciliation.note: validate computes its receipt tree with read-tree HEAD then add -A on a temporary index, so it includes untracked files and anything the run itself regenerated
receiptTreeReconciliation.difference: the receipt tree equals the committed tree plus the regenerated audit/cross-section-integrity.json and .md
receiptTreeReconciliation.provedBy: git diff-tree between the receipt tree and the worktree tree named exactly those two paths and nothing else
receiptTreeReconciliation.isThatDriftFromThisWork: no — with every acceptance-pass change stashed, a pristine b870be5 regenerates the same file with 216 invariants against the committed 222, so the drift is pre-existing and is reported rather than committed
receiptTreeReconciliation.forOwnerReview: these six are absent from a fresh audit-cross-section run on the branch AND on pristine b870be5. Cross-section invariant 10b, Entity hover publication, still runs and passes 6/6 inside the full validation.

stalenessControls.ownerApplicationsTouched: none — 53 ordinary browser windows, VS Code and every other application left running
stalenessControls.availableMemoryAtStart: 1.3 GB of 15.7 GB; the machine was already paging. Recorded because contention is the documented cause of past flaky gates, and this run had zero failures anyway.
